_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Member 03 of the bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant chain. Declares schema-level validation for BBVProgramme + BudgetBBVMapping. Validation lives at the OpenRegister schema layer so invalid data cannot be persisted regardless of which client writes it. Constraints declared here: BBVProgramme.programmeName required + non-empty + ≤ 255 chars; BBVProgramme.programmeCode regex ^\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?$ + uniqueness per (administrationId, fiscalYear); BBVProgramme.fiscalYear integer 1900–2100 (broader than slice 01/02's 2000–2100 to satisfy the historical-amendment use case); BBVProgramme.status enum validated by slice 02 (draft|active|archived); BudgetBBVMapping.glAccountNumber FK existence against Chart of Accounts (Account.accountNumber within the same administrationId); BudgetBBVMapping.allocationPercentage number 0–100 with 0.01 precision (multipleOf 0.01); BudgetBBVMapping.effectiveFrom required ISO-8601 date; BudgetBBVMapping.effectiveTo optional ISO-8601 date that MUST be ≥ effectiveFrom when present; per-account allocation sum MUST stay ≤ 100% per (administrationId, glAccountNumber, fiscalYear) within ±0.1% rounding tolerance (the tolerance window 99.9–100.1% interpretation from: sums above 100.1% are rejected). Cross-field rules use x-openregister-calculations validator expressions per ADR-031 (mirrors the convention used by bookings-availability-rules.json). FK existence and the cross-record allocation-sum invariant use x-openregister-validation declarative rules. These are honoured by the OpenRegister save pipeline, return HTTP 400 with the declared error message on violation, and are never enforced from a Vue/PHP service layer (ADR-022 / giant D2). Slug additions only re-declare the schemas the chain owns (BBVProgramme + BudgetBBVMapping); ADR-037 deep-merge unions on schema key so this fragment overlays slice 01 + 02 cleanly. This member ships no controllers, services, or UI. Those land in slices 04+.

BBVProgramme.title: BBV Programme
BBVProgramme.description: Slice-03 augments BBVProgramme with declarative validation: programmeName non-empty + ≤ 255 chars; programmeCode regex ^\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?$ + unique per (administrationId, fiscalYear); fiscalYear 1900–2100. Lifecycle, aggregations, and RBAC remain owned by slices 01 + 02. Invalid writes return HTTP 400 (ADR-005 fail-closed).

programmeCode.description: Waterboard-assigned BBV programme code per BBV-Waterschappen kostentoedeling. Format: numeric segments separated by dots, two or three levels deep (e.g. '1.1' or '2.3.2'). Validated by the regex constraint and the per-(administrationId, fiscalYear) uniqueness rule below.
programmeCode.title: Programme Code

programmeName.description: Operator-facing programme name displayed in dashboards and exports. Required, non-empty, capped at 255 characters.
programmeName.title: Programme Name

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year the programme applies to. Bounded 1900–2100 to accommodate historical amendments and future-year planning.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

programmeCodeUniquePerYear.description: Per, programmeCode SHALL be unique within (administrationId, fiscalYear). Two BBVProgramme records sharing all three values MUST be rejected on save.
programmeCodeUniquePerYear.errorMessage: A BBV programme with this code already exists for the selected fiscal year. Programme codes must be unique per (administration, fiscalYear).

BudgetBBVMapping.title: Budget BBV Mapping
BudgetBBVMapping.description: Slice-03 augments BudgetBBVMapping with declarative validation: glAccountNumber FK existence against Chart of Accounts; allocationPercentage 0–100 with 0.01 precision; effectiveFrom required ISO-8601 date; effectiveTo optional, MUST be ≥ effectiveFrom; per-account allocation sum MUST stay ≤ 100% within ±0.1% tolerance per (administrationId, glAccountNumber, fiscalYear). Invalid writes return HTTP 400 (ADR-005 fail-closed).

glAccountNumber.description: GL account number contributing to the programme. MUST exist in the Chart of Accounts (Account.accountNumber) within the same administrationId: enforced by the glAccountForeignKey rule in x-openregister-validation below.
glAccountNumber.title: GL Account Number

allocationPercentage.description: Share of the GL account's budget + spend allocated to this programme. Number in [0, 100] with 0.01 precision. Multiple mappings for one (administrationId, glAccountNumber, fiscalYear) MUST not exceed 100% (±0.1% tolerance): enforced by the allocationSumPerAccount rule in x-openregister-validation below.
allocationPercentage.title: Allocation Percentage

effectiveFrom.description: First date the mapping is in effect (inclusive). Required ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Last date the mapping is in effect (inclusive). Optional ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). When present MUST be ≥ effectiveFrom: enforced by the effectiveToOnOrAfterFrom cross-field validator below.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

effectiveToOnOrAfterFrom.description: Cross-field validator: rejects mappings where effectiveTo is set and earlier than effectiveFrom. Returns null when valid, an error string when invalid. Empty/null effectiveTo is treated as open-ended and skips the check.
effectiveToOnOrAfterFrom.expression: @self.effectiveTo == null || @self.effectiveTo >= @self.effectiveFrom ? null : 'effectiveTo must be on or after effectiveFrom'

glAccountForeignKey.description: Per, glAccountNumber SHALL reference an existing Chart-of-Accounts entry (Account.accountNumber) within the same administrationId. Mappings referencing an unknown GL account MUST be rejected on save.
glAccountForeignKey.errorMessage: Referenced GL account does not exist in the Chart of Accounts for this administration.

allocationSumPerAccount.description: Per / giant Phase 4: the sum of allocationPercentage across all BudgetBBVMapping records for a single GL account in a single fiscal year SHALL NOT exceed 100% within a ±0.1% rounding tolerance (i.e. sums in (100.1, ∞) are rejected; sums in [99.9, 100.1] are accepted; sums in [0, 99.9) are accepted as work-in-progress). The check runs on every create/update and considers the proposed record together with all sibling records sharing the same (administrationId, glAccountNumber, fiscalYear).
allocationSumPerAccount.errorMessage: Total allocation for this GL account in this fiscal year would exceed 100%. Reduce one of the mappings' allocationPercentage so the sum stays within ±0.1% of 100%.
